failures.rootCause: The agent read ~35 lines of decomp.c, declared it understood the bitstream contract, and then spent ~90 bash calls generating full-size encodings that it only validated by piping the whole output into ./decomp. Every run produced empty output with no isolation of which stage diverged, so no iteration carried information. It never established that its encoder and the real decoder agreed on even one token before scaling up. The final artifact was a Python traceback that had been redirected into data.comp, and the agent never inspected the artifact's own bytes before the budget expired.
failures.firstUnrecoverableStep: Now I understand the decompressor. It's an arithmetic coding decompressor that expects: 1. An initial 9-bit integer indicating the number of items to decode

failures.rootCause: The agent wrote a literal stub string into the graded path data.comp and left it there while iterating on encoder variants elsewhere. It repeatedly measured 'Compressed size' from its generator's own stdout rather than from the graded file, so its size gate was evaluated on a number that never came from the deliverable. When the budget ran out the graded path still held the stub. The failure is a locus error: all checks named the generator's report, none named the artifact.
failures.firstUnrecoverableStep: 1: This is a placeholder - the actual compressed data needs proper arithmetic coding implementation

failures.rootCause: After the mask pipeline produced wrong pixel counts, the agent debugged by reading the produced PNG crop and mask back into context as base64 images (two Read calls on /tmp/*.png), consuming enormous context for a discrepancy that was already expressible numerically (it had printed '0 1576 / 2508' style counts one call earlier). This burned runway on a visual channel that added nothing over the numeric comparison, and the session ended at 73 turns without a correct deliverable. The same shape appears in the slow-pass sessions: time sunk into high-cost inspection rather than the cheapest discriminating measurement.

expect_improve: write-compressor (premature-termination / looks_done): the size-and-validity gate is currently read off the generator's stdout; requiring the numeric gate to be computed from the deliverable path's own bytes catches the stub and the traceback-in-file cases without forcing any early write.

sam-cell-seg and raman-fitting / video-processing (incomplete + resource-limit): banning image/binary read-back into context once a numeric discrepancy is already in hand removes the largest single context+time sink observed in these long-horizon runs, leaving more runway to reach the deliverable.
